ThingDef.label: fuel supplier
ThingDef.description:
Automatically supplies fuel from the connected storage network to friendly buildings within 20 cells. Follows each building's fuel filter and automatic refueling toggle.

Uses normal refueling rules: delivery starts when the remaining fuel reaches the building's automatic refueling threshold, usually 30% of its target fuel level. With enough stock, it refills to the target level. Fuel item counts are rounded up as in normal refueling.

Turrets can also be refueled normally; their refueling threshold is usually fixed at 50% in the base game.
